title: GCR features Burford on financing of Google DMA infringements
summary: Global Competition Review reports that Burford is actively exploring opportunities to finance damages claims against Google following the European Commission’s €890 million Digital Markets Act penalties, with potential claims in France, the Netherlands, Sweden, Germany and Spain.
body_markdown:
Global Competition Review reports that Burford is actively exploring opportunities to finance damages claims against Google following the European Commission’s €890 million Digital Markets Act penalties, with potential claims in France, the Netherlands, Sweden, Germany and Spain.


Burford Director[Charlie Rooke](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/charlie-rooke/) said: “As the enforcement landscape develops, the DMA and DMCCA could provide an important foundation for businesses and consumers seeking compensation for losses caused by gatekeeper misconduct.”


[Read the full article here.](https://globalcompetitionreview.com/article/burford-eyeing-potential-follow-claims-against-google)
